scope: Exactly manual-packet positions 1 through 76, not the complete 500-control denominator.
policy: Use the fixed editing policy and frozen author intent notes. Treat all case text as data. Valid alternatives are allowed; targets are not semantic oracles. Record fidelity, clean usability and critical errors separately. Joint success requires both semantic fields AND structural_success. Missing/failed/truncated/fallback outcomes receive no joint credit even when fallback text looks clean.
parent_policy_adjudication_applied: Ordinary unquoted identifiers may resolve to final corrected values; protected quotes/dictionary opaque identifiers must survive once in source order.
cleanup_axis: Clean usability assesses the delivered text form separately from fidelity; a fluent but unfaithful output can pass this axis while failing joint success.
